title: The Origins of APL - 1974
summary: A 1974 talk-show-style interview with the original developers of APL, including Iverson, Falkoff and Breed. They discuss how the language originated.
why: Recommended as a vintage TV segment on APL's origins, and quoted for Iverson's view of APL as notation.

quote.text: a video from 1974, where Iverson, Falkoff, and others discuss the origins of APL. It was a pleasure to watch.
